title: INVOL (OPR) ? VOL (Airport Agent No ACNP, +ve Later) � Positive VOL Deducted from Delay
description:
AC applied an OPR operational re-protection (INVOL), then customer at the airport voluntarily changed to an even LATER flight (airport office ID, no ACNP = +ve VOL). The extra 2 hours added are DEDUCTED from total delay.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Gabriel Lachance); 1 leg AC YUL?YYZ; Original (14-day) arrival: 10:00; Change 1 (D-0): OPR (YTOAC00PR) ? new arrival 15:00; Change 2 (D-0): Airport VOL (airport office ID, no ACNP) ? customer goes LATER, new arrival 17:00 (+2hrs added); Actual arrival: 17:00; Code: 42 (Controllable); 72 hrs elapsed; No duplicate; Not employee; Not infant
